subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should `onProgressNarratorLifecycle`, `isProgressDraftVisible`, and `progressPreambleEnabled` become the canonical public Plugin SDK contract for channel-owned progress presentation?
rationale: The implementation is additive and well tested, but public Plugin SDK permanence and ownership cannot be inferred from contributor prose or green checks alone.

options.title: Approve the channel-owned seam
options.body: Accept the three optional fields as the supported lifecycle contract and merge after exact-head review and checks complete.

options.title: Keep the lifecycle internal
options.body: Remove the public fields and provide an internal channel-runtime bridge until maintainers are ready to commit to an external SDK contract.

options.title: Pause the combined change
options.body: Defer the PR if the time-gate fix should land separately from the headline and public SDK expansion.

recommendation.title: Approve the channel-owned seam
recommendation.body: Accept the three optional fields as the supported lifecycle contract and merge after exact-head review and checks complete.
